FS-07A.detail: The corresponding author must confirm whether any competing interests exist before a declaration is entered.

FS-07B.detail: All authors must confirm their CRediT roles; roles must not be inferred from author order.

FS-08.detail: All authors must confirm names, affiliations, funding, correspondence, acknowledgements, and any funding-role statement before submission.

FS-09.detail: The data owner must approve the final public/restricted data-availability wording.

FS-10.detail: Confirm revision deadline, upload item types, and final filenames in Editorial Manager.
